6 تساهموا : see 8. ―
-b2- [Hence, They shared together.] El-Hakam El-Khudree says, “ثَوْبَاهَا فَفِى الدِّرْعِ رَادَةٌ تَسَاهَمَ
وَفَى المِرْطِ لَفَّاوَانِ رِدْفُهُمَا عَبْلُ
” i. e. Her two garments shared together; for in the shift was a soft, or tender, body, with a slender waist, and within the waist-wrapper were too thick thighs whereof the part above them, behind, was large. (Ham p. 579.) ―
-b3- Also They contended [for a thing], one with another. (JM.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
